description: Implementation of ProductOptionService, handling CRUD operations for product options, including listing by store, reading attributes, and deletion logic within a sales management system.

classes.name: ProductOptionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing ProductOption entities, providing methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting product options within a store context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of product options available in a specific store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a read-only list of product options for a store in a specific language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches product options by name within a merchant store, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product option and associated product attributes from the store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option based on its code within a store.
